summary: The AI Act Scientific Panel is a group of independent scientists tasked with advising the European Union on the technical and ethical implications of artificial intelligence. They review AI risks, propose safety and transparency standards, and help shape regulations that keep AI systems reliable, trustworthy, and aligned with societal values.

summary: This document is the second draft of a Code of Practice for AI, providing a framework of guidelines and standards to ensure responsible and ethical use of AI technologies. title: Code of Practice: 3rd Draft
summary: This document presents the third draft of a Code of Practice for AI, outlining principles and guidelines for responsible design, development, and deployment. title: AI Pact Draft
summary: The AI Pact Draft proposes a set of principles and guidelines aimed at ensuring responsible development and use of artificial intelligence. It seeks to promote transparency, accountability, and ethical considerations across AI systems to protect users and society.

title: AI Pact Final
summary: The AI Pact Final is a comprehensive agreement that outlines shared principles and commitments for the responsible design, use, and governance of artificial intelligence technologies. It aims to ensure that AI is developed safely, transparently, and in ways that respect human rights and promote societal benefits.

title: Guidelines on prohibited artificial intelligence (AI) practices

title: EuroHPC Initiative for Start-Ups
summary: The EuroHPC Initiative for Start‑Ups is a program designed to help new businesses access high‑performance computing resources across Europe. It offers funding, training, and infrastructure support so startups can develop and scale advanced computing solutions.
